files.description: HL7 CDA R2 XML Schema (POCD_MT000040) for the CCD/C-CDA clinical document format. This is the primary EHI export schema. Contains 88 complex types defining clinical document structure. Includes vendor comment: 'Supported EHI export format(s) : XML'.
HL7 v3 data type schema referenced by the CCD schema. Defines 62 complex/simple types for coded values, identifiers, timestamps, addresses, and other HL7 data types.
HL7 v3 vocabulary schema referenced by the CCD schema. Defines 183 simple types with 657 enumeration values for coded fields (act codes, role codes, entity types, etc.).
CDA narrative block schema for structured text content in clinical documents (tables, lists, paragraphs, rendered content).
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses all 4 XSD schema files and extracts complex types, simple types, elements, attributes, and enumeration values into queryable JSON.
Structured JSON extraction from all 4 schema files. Contains 150 complex types, 183 simple types, 880 elements, and 657 enumeration values. Queryable for downstream analysis.
Documentation for the enrichment extraction process including run commands, input files, and known limitations.
